rationale: Three minutes into the trade, ERAS continues to consolidate tightly within a 3-cent range ($15.30–$15.33) on declining 1-minute volume right at its 5-minute 9-EMA ($15.34). The price remains well above both the session VWAP ($14.88) and the $15.18 invalidation level, keeping the original thesis of a low-volume contraction before a potential retest of the $15.78 session high completely intact.
